pages.title: Structure
pages.text: Path: $(thing)data/<namespace>/economic_product/<any name>.json$().$(br2)$(br){"entries": [$(br)  {"item": "minecraft:apple", "price": 8},$(br)  {"tag": "fid:fruit", "price": 8}$(br)]}$(br2)$(thing)item$() or $(thing)tag$(), plus $(thing)price$() — the base buy price per $(bold)stack of 64$().

pages.title: Priority and expansion
pages.text: $(li)Config $(thing)products.entries$() is read first, then data packs; $(bold)data packs win$() for the same item.$(br)$(li)Entries without a price fall back to $(thing)products.default_price$().$(br)$(li)Tag entries cannot be expanded during the listener pass, so they expand once at the end of reload and again on $(thing)TagsUpdatedEvent$().

pages.title: What it drives
pages.text: These products only drive the daily price table on the news page: each day a price is rolled within $(thing)volatility_percent$() of the base price, marked as up or down and never below 0.$(br2)This is a $(bold)quote$(); actual checkout still uses the $(thing)price$() written in shop entries — change both if you want them to agree.
